title: Brand AI-Readiness Audit Report
description: Output contract for the marketplace entrypoint. Fields marked required are the contest-mandated floor; everything else is an documented extension. verify_report.py enforces this contract plus an additional evidence-quality gate.

site.description: Canonical host actually audited, resolved after redirects.

audited_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp ending in Z.

ai_readiness_score.description: EXTENSION. Mean of the five pillar scores. Comparable across runs of the same site, not across different sites.

id.description: Assigned by the entrypoint in ranked order.

evidence.description: Concrete, checkable observation. Must cite a measured quantity (counts, ratios, status codes) and, where applicable, verbatim excerpts and URLs. Enforced by verify_report.py.

summary.description: What to change, in one sentence.

effort.description: EXTENSION. Tracked separately from severity so impact and cost can be traded off.

owner.description: EXTENSION. Which function should act: web/dev, content, marketing, infrastructure, design, legal.

check_id.description: EXTENSION. Stable id from references/finding-catalog.md. Makes every finding traceable to a named, documented check.

pillar.description: EXTENSION. Which stage of the visibility pipeline this belongs to.

confidence.description: EXTENSION. How directly the evidence was measured. See severity-model.md.

affected_urls.description: EXTENSION. Up to 20 example URLs exhibiting the defect.

metrics.description: EXTENSION. Raw measurements behind the evidence string.

blocked_by.description: EXTENSION. Check id of an access gate that makes this fix ineffective until resolved. Composition rule 1.

confounded_by.description: EXTENSION. Check id explaining why this may be an artefact of the audit's own limits. Composition rule 2. Always accompanied by confidence:low.

verification.description: EXTENSION. Exact command or method to confirm a non-measured finding.

related_check_ids.description: EXTENSION. Other findings sharing this root cause. Composition rule 3.

proactive.description: EXTENSION. True where no defect exists but an opportunity does.

informational.description: EXTENSION. True for deliberate trade-offs reported for awareness, not as defects (e.g. REACH-002).

evidence_source.description: EXTENSION. For off-site findings, the probe id whose results support this.

scope.description: EXTENSION. What was actually audited, so the reader can judge coverage.

method.description: EXTENSION. How the audit was performed, including which checks ran.

limitations.description: EXTENSION, and load-bearing. Everything the audit could NOT establish. A check that did not run appears here and is never reported as passing.

root_causes.description: EXTENSION. Findings grouped by shared underlying cause. Composition rule 3.

proactive_recommendations.description: EXTENSION. Improvements worth making even where no defect was detected.

remediation_plan.description: EXTENSION. Findings and recommendations sequenced into four phases; each item appears in exactly one.

notes.description: EXTENSION. Observations from sub-skills, including checks that passed and what satisfied them.
